Hi Anja- Jordan
In February,  a week or two before the last war started, we sent an appointment request. Then, I received the SMS with the automatic extension until August. 

We have never received an answer about our request. 

Last Friday we received a "reminder" for an appointment for the past Sunday. My husband checked his account in the app but there was no appointment there. In addition he could not go that day and we did not have the documents prepared. 
So, we sent an email explaining the situation and requested a new appointment through the website, and they gave us one for October. 

I read in the AIC that it is not necessary to get a new sticker if we have the sms confirmation (if I am not mistaken) Anyway I am not ease with all those things expired.. I plan to go next week to get at least a multi entry and clarify all this personally
